prompt:
Generate exactly 4 independent desktop SaaS UI prototype images as a cohesive matched set for the same Chinese product named 灵境智创. The API will return 4 images. Make each image a different full-page screen, but keep the same brand, sidebar, menu wording, icon style, spacing, typography, colors, and component language across all images.

Global design system for all 4 images:
- Brand name: 灵境智创
- Style: light enterprise SaaS inspired by modern AI design tools, original brand, no external logos, no browser chrome, no watermark.
- Colors: background #F5F7FA, surface #FFFFFF, text #111827, muted #6B7280, border #E5E7EB, primary #2563EB, success #16A34A, warning #F59E0B, danger #EF4444.
- Typography: Inter / PingFang SC, H1 24/32 semibold, H2 18/26, body 14/22, small 12/18.
- Layout rules: 220px left sidebar, 24px page padding, 16px grid gap, 20px card padding, 8px card radius, 40px button height.
- Same rounded 2px stroke line icon style. Blue active menu item. Neutral inactive menu items.
- Chinese labels must be crisp and readable.

For images 1-3 use exactly this frontend sidebar, same order and wording:
品牌区: 灵境智创 / 电商 AI 工作台
分组 工作台: 总览, 在线体验
分组 创作中心: 电商智能体, 商品图生成, 商品短视频
分组 资产中心: 模板中心, 资产库, 任务记录
分组 管理: 系统设置
Do not add, remove, rename, translate, or reorder these menu items.

For image 4 use exactly this admin sidebar, same order and wording:
品牌区: 灵境智创 / 后台管理
分组 配置中心: 模型配置, 上游渠道, 电商平台, 提示词模板, 风格模板
分组 数据中心: 生成记录, 用量统计
分组 系统: 系统设置
Do not add, remove, rename, translate, or reorder these menu items.

Image 1 content: 电商智能体 workbench. Active menu: 电商智能体. Large prompt composer with placeholder 输入商品名、卖点、规格、平台要求，让 AI 生成卖货素材. Scene tabs 商品主图, 商品短视频, Listing文案, 竞品调研, A+详情页. Feature cards 商品套图, 爆款视频, 图文复刻, 详情页结构. Right panel 最近任务. Small design tokens card.

Image 2 content: 商品短视频 generation flow. Active menu: 商品短视频. Prompt editor fields 秒数, 镜头, 灯光, 背景, 声音, 细节描述. Model dropdown Seedance-2.0-D-V. Progress panel states 提交, 排队中, 生成中 48%, 完成. Error log with timestamps. 9:16 video preview. Buttons 预览, 提示词, 下载, 重新生成. Quick templates 15秒开箱, 5秒卖点特写, TikTok口播, 场景种草.

Image 3 content: 模板中心 and asset library. Active menu: 模板中心. Search, category tabs 电商设计, 视频创作, 社媒营销, 品牌设计, 办公设计. Sections 商品套图模板, 爆款视频模板, 主图风格, 详情页结构. Cards with buttons 预览 and 做同款. Right panel 最近生成.

Image 4 content: 后台提示词模板 admin. Active menu: 提示词模板. Tabs 图片模板, 视频模板, 文案模板. Filters and 新建模板 button. Table columns 名称, 适用场景, 模型, 默认, 状态, 更新时间, 操作. Right editor drawer fields 名称, 场景, 提示词结构, 变量, 模型下拉, 时长秒数, 生成音频, 保存.

Each image should be 1536x1024 full desktop screen, not a collage, not a 2x2 board. The four outputs should look like pages from the same real product.
